faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Government of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Government of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Block Coordinator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Government of Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Standard Form) and send it to The Office of the Child Development Project Officer, Jirang ICDS Project, P. O. New Jirang - 781131, Ri Bhoi District, by by post or in person, to reach by 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in any discipline with at least 2 years experience of working with technology and software application support.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who are domicile of Jirang C & RD Block. Mandatorily local candidates should be engaged. Good oral and written communication in local language.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without the desirable qualifications/experience need not apply.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of Posting: Upto 31.03.2027. On contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Jirang C & RD Block.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 2 (two) attested passport size photographs; Attested copies of certificates; Self addressed envelope size 4.5 x 11 cms.
